description: This PHP source file defines the Framework class, which extends Symfony's HttpKernel to set up and manage the core components of the OrangeHRM web application, including dependency injection, routing, logging, and request handling.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: A class extending Symfony's HttpKernel to initialize and configure core services, routing, logging, and request handling for the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Framework object, sets environment and debug mode, and configures container and logger.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Registers core services and dependencies into the service container.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logging service and adds a logger subscriber.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing components, including route matching, URL generation, and event listeners for request handling.

methods.name: configurePlugins
methods.description: Loads and initializes plugins based on configuration.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming HTTP request, configuring routing and plugins before delegating to parent handler.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.
